articles.title: Study Points to Europe as the Birthplace of Bats
articles.summary: Combining 103 bat genomes and 44 fossils, an international team says bats likely originated in Europe 65-60 million years ago, with flight and echolocation appearing early.

articles.title: Textile Cover Boosts Strawberry Yields More Than Threefold in Trials
articles.summary: Plant Armor, a 3-D porous textile, blocked insects and raised strawberry yields up to 3.56 times in tunnel trials while letting light, rain and air through, researchers report.

articles.title: Study: Target Large Female Pythons to Slow Florida Invasion
articles.summary: A Weighted Removal Index based on age, sex and season suggests large adult female Burmese pythons should be prioritized, and winter hunts may be more effective than summer ones.
